messages:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 spike observed for streaming/generate across us-west-2. SLO breach window >=5m. @oncall please respond
anna_ops: replying. p95 ~390ms, p99 ~1.6s for streaming. spike began 3123499955 per graphite. some streams showing partial frames/stalls
raj_infra: looking at serving pools: concentrated on gpu-pool-3; top offender node is rack12-gpu07 (slot 7)
carlos_sre: any kernel or device errors? customers reported truncated streams and reconnects
anna_ops: kernel logs show repeated "GPU0: Correctable ECC error" and NVLink retransmit warnings. temps peaked ~81C. sample: `[3123499992] GPU0 ECC corrected count 27, thermal=81`
lee_hw: that profile suggests soft-throttle and ECC noise. with sustained thermal we'd hit periodic kernel backoffs that stall the KV-cache threads
raj_infra: profiling token loop: long waits on cudaStreamSynchronize and occasional host fallback; fallback adds ~450-700ms per request in our perf tests
carlos_sre: immediate mitigations?
anna_ops: options: 1) cordon & drain node to stop new streams; 2) route traffic away from pool3 to pool5 via smart-router weight shift; 3) enable degraded kernel path/8-bit quantized model for low-priority classes; 4) lower batch_size for streaming on receiving pools
carlos_sre: do step 1 and 2 now. run: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-rack12-07 && kubectl drain gpu-node-rack12-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
raj_infra: performing drain at 3123500030, applying router weight patch to prefer pool5/pool6 for streaming. active session handoff in progress
oncall-bot: @anna_ops acknowledged. Please include severity and impact in the incident timeline
anna_ops: drain in flight. lowering streaming batch size on pool5 from 12 -> 6: `rlimit.batch_size=12 -> 6` applied via rollout at 3123500055
lee_hw: hardware note: fans reporting normal RPM but sensor jitter on internal diags. recommend remote diagnostics and standby replacement if ECC persists
raj_infra: after reroute and batch tweak p95 dropped to ~210ms within 90s. p99 trending down but still 700-1kms for some tails
anna_ops: observed KV-cache stall count reduce from 48->8 in last 6m. rack12-gpu07 still spitting corrected-ECC entries despite being drained (27->9 more events)
carlos_sre: customer impact: ~180 requests >1s in last 12m. mostly experimental/test orgs + 3 dedicated customers. not yet SLA breach but close for some agreements. start drafting comms if p99 stays >1.5s beyond 30m
lee_hw: opening hardware hot-ticket HT-83499 for immediate diagnostics and pre-approved swap. remote probe scheduled; if we see uncorrectable ECC we'll plan hot-swap and thermal verification
raj_infra: migration finished at 3123500098; node unschedulable. keeping it drained and monitoring fallback effectiveness
oncall-bot: Incident severity bumped to Sev2 by incident-bot. Pager: @raj_infra primary, @carlos_sre backup
anna_ops: enabled auto-fallback to model-quantized-8bit for non-interactive routes; also throttling low-priority orgs by rate-limit to reduce noise
raj_infra: metrics at 3123500125: p95=205ms, p99=680ms, streaming stalls down to 4. KV-cache stall metrics normalized
lee_hw: remote diagnostics started 3123500150. collecting ECC counters, thermal history, and nvlink error logs. if hardware clearance fails we'll swap GPU and reseat power connectors
carlos_sre: actions assigned: hw (lee) investigate and swap if needed; infra (raj) keep node drained and validate router weights; ops (anna) continue monitoring + prepare customer notes. escalate to Sev1 if p99 >2s or uncorrectable ECC observed
anna_ops: incident page created and updated: https://internal.redwood/incident/3123500001. adding timeline, logs, and sample traces
raj_infra: standing by in channel. will ping when replacement proceeds or if metrics regress
lee_hw: current status (3123500170): p95=200ms, p99=650ms, rack12-gpu07 continues to log corrected ECC events but no UEs. node remains drained and hardware ticket HT-83499 open. monitoring continues :white_check_mark:
